description: This file implements PagerDuty alerting integration for monitoring high failure rates and hanging requests in a system, with methods for logging events, threshold-based alerting, and sending notifications to PagerDuty.

classes.name: PagerDutyAlerting
classes.description: A class that extends SlackAlerting to provide PagerDuty alerting for failed and hanging requests, with threshold-based alerting and event management.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Records a failure event and triggers an alert if failure threshold is exceeded within a time window.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook that initiates hanging request detection.

methods.name: hanging_response_handler
methods.description: Checks if a request is hanging by waiting a threshold and recording hanging events.

methods.name: _send_alert_if_thresholds_crossed
methods.description: Prunes old events, checks if threshold is crossed, and sends alert if needed.

methods.name: _build_error_summaries
methods.description: Creates short summaries of recent error events for alert details.

methods.name: send_alert_to_pagerduty
methods.description: Sends an alert message to PagerDuty via API.
